sam: Quick async check-in for late ops shift — SLOs, alerts, and follow-ups. Please do a 1-2 line what I did / blockers / today. I'll collect action items.

maria: Did: lowered pager sensitivity for batcher-queue to reduce noise, pushed runbook note for 504s. Blocker: seeing ~15% false positives from synthetic checks between 02:10-02:20 UTC. Today: will iterate debounce and check synthetic PR. :memo:

alex: Did: rolled a small kv-cache eviction tweak on canary, ran smoke tests. Blocker: noticed repeated `grpc: deadline exceeded` in the canary logs during warmup. Sample: ```
[02:12:08] grpc: deadline exceeded (while calling /inference/predict)
[02:12:09] retrying request id=bd3a...
```
Today: adding more granular traces and increasing warmup replication factor.

jordan: Did: finished alert-migration doc and sent to infra-team. Blocker: none. Today: will QA the migration on staging.

oncall-bot: deploy: canary/kv-evict-tweak v1.3.4 -> deployed to us-west-2-canary at 02:15 UTC :rocket:

maria: @alex can you paste the full grep you used for the 02:12 timeframe? want to correlate with synthetic pings.

alex: grep command I used:
```bash
journalctl -u inference-canary --since "2026-02-18 02:10" --until "2026-02-18 02:22" | grep -E "grpc: deadline exceeded|retrying request"
```
Found ~27 entries across 3 hosts, mostly immediately after warmup spikes.

sam: Ok — provisional hypothesis: warmup + concurrent synthetic check -> transient grpc timeouts that bubble as alert noise. Action items: 1) maria: adjust synthetic check timing to avoid coinciding with warmup (stagger by 30s) and test on staging. 2) alex: add trace IDs to retries + increase warmup replicas from 2 -> 4 in canary, monitor 10m. 3) jordan: run alert-migration QA and confirm no regression with new debounce. 4) sam: I'll update the SLO notes and file a short postmortem if noise persists.

maria: ACK — scheduling stagger, will post results here and link PR. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2789 :white_check_mark:

alex: I'll open a tiny trace PR and run canary again. Will ping in-thread when done.

jordan: QA started on staging, will report any alert deltas.

oncall-bot: incident reminder: oncall rotation for 02/20 includes @jordan -> please confirm coverage.

sam: noted. If anyone needs handoff tonight, drop a note. Thanks — short sync, no ops page escalation yet. :thumbsup:
